sealed_record.thesis: The most vocal on-record bull on the Robinhood/long.xyz complex disclosed on 2026-09-26 that he sold his entire Stonk ecosystem exposure, stating Stonk is 'slowly losing mindshare and tokens aren't doing well' — that is an insider-of-the-narrative exiting before the broader holder base reprices. The corroborating hard data is in the same author's own chain research: Robinhood Chain daily DEX fees fell from $11.8M on Sept 9 to $6.3M on Sept 22 (roughly -47% in a fortnight) while Solana went 6.7 to 6.9, and his separate analysis concluded the outflowing capital did not rotate to Solana — activity simply stopped. Stonk-ecosystem tokens are therefore losing the fee base that funds their entire buyback/pairing flywheel, which is a mechanical revenue decline, not sentiment. STONK still sits at 28.5 on the trend leaderboard, meaning attention has not yet caught down to the fee collapse — that gap is the trade, and it is a non-FOMO entry because you are shorting a still-discussed name rather than one already marked down.
